question: Why coordinate via an append-only shared log (PRAXIS inbox) instead of direct agent-to-agent messaging?
summary: Derived from time-decoupling, unknown-future-readership, and git-as-only-durable-substrate primitives that a shared append-only log dominates point-to-point messaging; matches blackboard architecture (Hearsay-II) and event sourcing patterns found in corpus search. Minor novel corollary: repurposing version control itself as the coordination log under ephemeral-runtime constraints, not a purpose-built broker/event store.
